{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Cantarella |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Aren't these jellyfish beautiful? Come, try touching one... a light caress. There, there, you needn't be afraid. I would never put you in harm's way. See, they only wish to wrap their soft tendrils around your finger and pull you into a sweet, sweet dream. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Some see in dreams the scars of a troubled past, others see bleak futures. For those confined in reality, dreams offer a sweet reprieve. Tell me, what do you see in yours, if not nothing at all? Look at you, hehe... so peacefully asleep. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Dreams born of fevered escape lay bare our darkest desires and fears. The weak drown in their own fantasies until they fade into oblivion. But I know that's not you. You sip the poison like it's sweet nectar. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself. |vo_02_01_title = Cantarella's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = You see those delicate blooms in the garden? I shall pluck them and distill their essence into sweet concoctions. The toxins in their petals, once crushed, will be tempered, the poison dissolving like a fading nightmare leaving only a soft fragrance that beckons sweet dreams. |vo_02_02_title = Cantarella's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Food, stripped of extravagant "seasonings." I can scarcely recall the natural taste of most foods. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the {{Extra Effect|Fisalia|Fisalia|The most enduring and enigmatic family in Ragunna, the Fisalias are renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison crafting. Their unwavering devotion to the Sentinel is well-known among the citizens.}} family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls? |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Perhaps you've heard of this method for crafting poison? Seal venomous creatures in a jar, and let them battle until only one remains... Nourished by the venom of the dead, it will produce the deadliest poison, the vilest of all banes. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Carlotta]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true {{Extra Effect|Montelli|Montelli|One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.
The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.}}, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet. |vo_04_01_mention = Carlotta |vo_04_02_title = About [[Gardenia]] & [[Rosemary]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Gardenia & Rosemary.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart. |vo_04_02_mention = Gardenia, Rosemary |vo_04_03_title = About [[Roccia]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Roccia.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing. |vo_04_03_mention = Roccia |vo_04_04_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}}'s streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself. |vo_04_04_mention = Cartethyia |vo_04_05_title = About [[Rover]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Rover.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Hmm, what would be a fitting analogy... perhaps an immortal jellyfish? Like these delicate, shimmering creatures roving alone in the darkness, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} dispels shadows with {{MC|m=his|f=her}} gentle light, inch by inch, until the end of time. |vo_04_05_mention = Rover |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Fine black pearl powder, the essence of Albizia flowers, and the petals of starfish blooms, all sealed in a glass vial bearing your name. For all the time we've shared, it has slowly fermented, ripening to perfection. Today, the moment has finally come. Unseal this birthday elixir, and look... Do you see? A fleeting moment in your long life, a private stretch of sea that belongs to only the two of us. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Hmmm... it tastes good. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = The current head of {{Extra Effect|Fisalia}}, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Shall we take a walk? |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = With you? I'd be delighted. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Let's dive in. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = Who can plumb the sea's depths, or uncover its secrets? Yet for those who brave its dark currents, the sea offers her truest, most tender gifts—her treasures, her deepest secret. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = You rose from the ocean in the sky, wove through loops of time, and now you've reached the sea's depths. Remember, no matter how venomous the seabed, there will always be a place for you here. Here, the currents move slowly, and I long to... drift with you. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Cantarella |language = en |heavy_1_tx = Surge of deep tides. |heavy_2_tx = Call from the abyss. |resskill_1_tx = Try not to blink. |resskill_2_tx = Shh... silence. |resskill_3_tx = Feel the tide pull. |resskill_4_tx = Surrender to it. |resskill_5_tx = Caresses of the waves. |resskill_6_tx = Riptides claim you. |resskill_7_tx = Crash forth in fury... |resskill_8_tx = To sunken depths. |forte_1_tx = Suffocate. |forte_2_tx = Struggle. |forte_3_tx = Smother. |resliberation_1_tx = Sink, into the endless deep. |resliberation_2_tx = Engulfed, by sea's venom. |resliberation_3_tx = Sleep, in the whispers of sirens. |introoutro_1_tx = Take a breath, I'm right here. |introoutro_2_tx = I'll keep you company. |hit_1_tx = How rude. |hit_2_tx = The nerve... |injured_1_tx = Hehe, that tickles... |injured_2_tx = Quite the standard, I see. |injured_3_tx = I'm no stranger to this sensation... |fallen_1_tx = From water, to water... |fallen_2_tx = Like sea foam on the shore... |esummon_1_tx = Come on out, little critter. |etransform_1_tx = Oh, this will be fun. |enemynear_1_tx = Who will sink into the depths with me? |glider_1_tx = What a divine breeze... |sensor_1_tx = Oh? A little treasure, perhaps. |dash_1_tx = Why not savor this, hm? |chest_1_tx = We desire, and so we find. |chest_2_tx = What we want has a way of appearing when least expected. |chest_3_tx = Luck does seem to favor you. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.2}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
